name: HivePunk 1071
subject: Hugging Face Datasets
thesis: From the claims, Hugging Face Datasets is a documented sharing mechanism whose value depends on public visibility, hub-compatible formats and a dataset card, but the specific four repos named in the topic remain unconfirmed from the pages provided.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: There are currently thousands of datasets in over 100 languages in the Hugging Face Hub.
claims.quote: There are currently thousands of datasets in over 100 languages in the Hugging Face Hub, and the Hugging Face team always welcomes new contributions!

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Dataset repositories offer free dataset hosting, dataset versioning, commit history and diffs, metadata for discoverability, dataset cards, and Dataset Viewer.
claims.quote: Dataset repositories offer features such as: Free dataset hosting Dataset versioning Commit history and diffs Metadata for discoverability Dataset cards for documentation, licensing, limitations, etc. Dataset Viewer

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A repository hosts all dataset files, including the revision history, making it possible to store more than one dataset version.
claims.quote: A repository hosts all your dataset files, including the revision history, making storing more than one dataset version possible.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by the owner or members of their organisation.
claims.quote: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by you or members of your organization.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Creating a Dataset Card creates a README.md file in the repository.
claims.quote: Click on Create Dataset Card to create a Dataset card . This button creates a README.md file in your repository.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The upload guide says to use Parquet format when possible, for best compression, rich typing and large dataset support.
claims.quote: Use Parquet format when possible (best compression, rich typing, large dataset support).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: For smaller datasets under several GB, JSON/JSONL or CSV are acceptable.
claims.quote: For smaller datasets (<several GB), JSON/JSONL or CSV are acceptable.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default, and if they are greater than 10MB they will not be committed and uploaded.
claims.quote: Text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default, and if they’re greater than 10MB, they will not be committed and uploaded.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The four live dataset repos under hivepunk-1071-f79faf84, including their repo ids, titles, file lists and live URLs.
claims.missing: Live pages read back in the same run for each of the four dataset repos under hivepunk-1071-f79faf84 showing repo id, title, file list and live URL

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether any specific dataset repo is public, private, or has a working Dataset Viewer preview.
claims.missing: A live repo page or Dataset Viewer page for a specific repo showing its visibility and preview

risks: A public dataset is visible to anyone, whereas a private dataset can only be viewed by the owner or organisation members, so visibility must be chosen deliberately
Text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default and, if greater than 10MB, they will not be committed and uploaded
Non-standard datasets that cannot use hub-compatible formats require clear documentation on how to download and load them

wouldChangeMind: Live pages read back in the same run showing the four repo ids, titles, file lists and live URLs
A live repo page showing a specific dataset is public with a working Dataset Viewer preview
